Draft for the family

Zaida Itchke

Rabbi Yitzchok Gansburg
Moscow 1927 — Crown Heights 2006

    Read it, and mark it up.

    This is the English edition as it stands — the prologue and thirteen chapters, from the Moscow basement to the engagement in the hospital, plus one chapter whose place in the book is not settled yet.

    Click any paragraph to leave a note on it — where you got bored, where something rings false, where you know the story differently, where a name or a date is wrong. At the end of each chapter, rate how gripping it was.

    The photographs are the real ones out of the archive — including the letters themselves. Where you see a dashed box, that is a picture we still have to find or commission; if you know where one is, say so in a note.

    Nothing is sent anywhere automatically. When you are done, press Send my notes at the bottom and you will get a file to email back. Your notes stay in this browser until then, so you can read over several sittings.

    Easiest is Send with Gmail — it opens Gmail in a new tab with your notes already written out, and you just press Send. If you do not use Gmail, Use my email app, or Copy and paste them into any email.

    The age is only so we can see whether the younger readers and the older readers want different things from the book. Leave it blank if you would rather not.
